minimal_build.compiler_command: cd /home/factiond/build; cc -std=c11 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fstack-protector-strong -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=2 -fPIE -pie -Wl,-z,relro,-z,now experiments/058-transport-memory/minimal-frontend.c crates/faction-unix/src/terminal_fd.c -o /usr/local/libexec/faction-ssh-minimal; chmod 755 /usr/local/libexec/faction-ssh-minimal; cc -std=c11 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fanalyzer -c experiments/058-transport-memory/minimal-frontend.c -o /tmp/minimal-analyzed.o; install -m 755 /usr/local/libexec/faction-ssh-minimal /usr/local/libexec/faction-ssh; readelf -W -h -l -d /usr/local/libexec/faction-ssh-minimal
minimal_build.note: Actual NetBSD ELF has no GNU_STACK header; no stack property inferred from its absence
